meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用ESM模型进行蛋白质序列分析与结构预测
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用ESM SDK做蛋白质折叠或序列研究
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein sequences and predict structures with ESM models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with ESM SDK for protein folding or sequence research

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 Python 调用 ESM 模型来生成蛋白质序列、预测结构、获取蛋白质嵌入向量，以及进行功能注释。
howto.when: 当你需要设计或分析蛋白质，比如生成新序列、预测蛋白质结构、计算序列相似性时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ESM3 生成一段 200 个氨基酸的荧光蛋白序列。
say.note: Claude 会调用 ESM3 模型生成序列。

say.text: 用 ESMC 计算这两段蛋白质序列的嵌入向量。
say.note: Claude 会调用 ESMC 模型获取嵌入。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you use Python to call ESM models for generating protein sequences, predicting structures, obtaining protein embeddings, and performing function annotations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design or analyze proteins, such as generating new sequences, predicting protein structures, or computing sequence similarities.

say_en.text: Generate a 200-residue fluorescent protein sequence using ESM3.
say_en.note: Claude will call the ESM3 model to generate the sequence.

say_en.text: Compute embeddings for these two protein sequences using ESMC.
say_en.note: Claude will call the ESMC model to get embeddings.
